Never edit observation.py, packages/, data/, docs/, worker/.

CONTEXT: the opt-in observation prompt (ItemFactsProvider.observation_request, see tests/test_observation_prompt.py) puts an `Already done:` line in PLAYER built from provider.prior_steps. For boarding, prior_steps includes each visible item's authored `notice_text` (seating.board_vehicle appends it to SeatingResult.steps, e.g. a sentence saying where an item sits). That per-item engine-written environment prose must NOT reach the narrator on the observation path: the narrator should learn item positions from the projected THINGS lines, and a package with no notice_text must behave identically. Other steps (the seat's enter_text, standing, taking, fixed-refusal steps, the generic already-in-seat sentence) are completed ACTIONS and stay.

CHANGE: (1) Add `notice_steps: tuple[str, ...] = ()` to SeatingResult in storygame/runtime/seating.py and have board_vehicle fill it with exactly the notice_text strings it appends; `steps` stays unchanged and still contains them, so every existing consumer and all default-path behavior is byte-identical. (2) In storygame/runtime/capture.py WorldCapture.before_turn, pass boarding.notice_steps to the provider as `provider.prior_notice_steps` (a tuple; reset to () wherever prior_steps is reset or the turn ends, mirror how prior_steps and command_consumed are handled, including any saved/restored context if prior_steps is persisted). (3) In ItemFactsProvider add `self.prior_notice_steps = ()` and, ONLY when observation_request is not None, build the `Already done:` line and ObservationContext completed_actions from prior_steps with those notice strings removed (remove by exact match, preserve order, remove each notice once); the default path keeps using prior_steps untouched. If no steps remain, add no Already done line. No story vocabulary in the code.

TESTS FIRST (append to tests/test_observation_prompt.py): (a) 'Enter the truck.' with observation_request set: the Already done line holds the seat step only and does not contain the notice sentence, while THINGS still lists the laptop with Place: passenger seat; (b) with observation_request None the PLAYER section still holds the full `Just before this:` line including the notice (default unchanged); (c) a package whose items have no notice_text (copy the real package to tmp_path and delete the notice_text keys from its world yaml as tests/test_seating.py does; or build the SeatingResult directly) yields identical observation prompts apart from nothing: Already done is the same seat step; (d) SeatingResult.notice_steps is a subset of steps and empty when no notice exists. Run them, see them fail, then build. FINISH: ruff check and ruff format every touched file; report pass counts.
